title: Final Lean Multi-WORK Smoke Test Checklist

items.label: Dispatch two final Lean Dispatch WORK rooms.
items.evidenceTarget: PLAN opens two real projectless no-edit WORK tasks with distinct lane IDs, roomRunIds, handoff IDs, and Active Return Commands.
items.verificationNote: PLAN opened alpha WORK task 01a061ef-080d-7842-895b-81e553d2a522 and beta WORK task 01a061ef-12a4-7612-8461-e3bf381e1ec4 under dispatch-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-2026-09-02-01 with parallelLimit 2, Work Type planning-coordination, and Active Return Command send_message_to_thread to PLAN task 01a05e34-5b16-7493-ac31-9baf8ba71454.

items.label: Receive the alpha automatic PASS return.
items.evidenceTarget: The alpha WORK room pushes its compact PASS Terminal Handoff back to PLAN without user copy/paste.
items.verificationNote: PLAN received WORK RETURN EVENT handoff-final-lean-alpha-pass-smoke-2026-09-02-01 from alpha through send_message_to_thread and assigned it completionQueue arrivalSequence 1.

items.label: Receive the beta intentional needs-revision return.
items.evidenceTarget: The beta WORK room pushes an intentional incomplete first handoff to PLAN so PLAN can test acceptanceGate needs-revision handling.
items.verificationNote: PLAN received WORK RETURN EVENT handoff-final-lean-beta-revision-smoke-2026-09-02-01 from beta through send_message_to_thread and assigned it completionQueue arrivalSequence 2. The handoff intentionally omitted tests/checks run and requested needs-revision.

items.label: Send a Revision Packet back to the same beta room.
items.evidenceTarget: PLAN sends the exact missing acceptanceGate field back to the original beta WORK task without opening a replacement room.
items.verificationNote: PLAN sent Revision Packet revision-final-lean-beta-revision-smoke-2026-09-02-01 to beta task 01a061ef-12a4-7612-8461-e3bf381e1ec4, preserving the original lane boundary and naming the missing tests/checks run field.

items.label: Receive the beta revised automatic PASS return.
items.evidenceTarget: The same beta WORK room receives the Revision Packet and pushes a revised compact PASS Terminal Handoff back to PLAN.
items.verificationNote: PLAN received WORK RETURN EVENT handoff-final-lean-beta-revision-smoke-2026-09-02-01-r1 from the same beta task through send_message_to_thread. The revised handoff included revisionAttempt 1, Revision Packet ID, tests/checks run, locator, no file changes, no commit, risks/unknowns, and Contract Change Request none.

items.label: Run the final Lean smoke acceptance gate.
items.evidenceTarget: PLAN accepts only the local no-edit orchestration result after checking compact handoff fields and same-room revision behavior.
items.verificationNote: PLAN accepted alpha as automatic PASS, classified beta first return as needs-revision because tests/checks run was missing, sent a Revision Packet to the same WORK room, then accepted beta revised PASS after all compact handoff fields were present.

items.label: Preserve final smoke boundaries.
items.evidenceTarget: The final smoke does not promote product repository behavior, map truth, release readiness, or future-environment guarantees.
items.verificationNote: Both WORK rooms were projectless no-edit planning-coordination lanes. The result supports only local Lean Dispatch return, queue, and same-room revision behavior; it does not prove product WORK edits, multi-product-WORK close-together return, queued clientThreadId dispatch, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, map truth, readiness, or release status.

items.label: Record Project Control final Lean smoke evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Phase, Checklist, Evidence, and Work required evidence for the final Lean Dispatch smoke result.
items.verificationNote: Registered phase-agent-and-skill-design-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-test, checklist-agent-and-skill-design-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-test, evidence-flowdoc-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-test-2026-09-02, and updated agent-and-skill-design phaseIds, requiredEvidence, summary, and riskSummary.

items.label: Verify the final Lean smoke evidence gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused final Lean smoke guard, generated read model, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: tests/flowdoc-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-evidence.test.ts, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
